protocol.checkpointSelection: Evaluate the final fixed adapter after 60 complete on-policy trajectories.
protocol.primaryMetric: Verified complete on-time success over 21 previously unused paired test scenarios.
protocol.branchReturn: On-time unit fraction + 0.70 * strict success - 0.05 * spend / budget - 0.003 * tool calls - 0.008 * rejections.
protocol.continuation: After the candidate from the Qwen menu, the public hand-written dispatcher continues to shift termination using its usual full action menu.
protocol.objective: Cross-entropy toward a temperature-softened counterfactual return distribution, blended with the frozen base policy. Downweight nearly indistinguishable outcomes. Maximize using rank-four residual logits and Adam.
